---
title: "Methods and sources"
---

## How this case study was built

**Interviews.** I conducted two semi-structured interviews on Microsoft Teams: Resident A on October 16, 2026 (about 40 minutes of conversation) and Resident B on October 19, 2026 (about 48 minutes). They were recorded with permission and transcribed with Teams' automatic transcription, then corrected against the audio. Interviewees are identified by role pending written confirmation of how they wish to be credited. Their identities and contact details were provided to the course instructor with the transcripts.

**Data.** Demographic figures are American Community Survey 2020–2024 five-year estimates (and 2006–2010 for change), compiled by the Atlanta Regional Commission for NPU-H, NSA H02 and the City of Atlanta. The data are in the `data/` folder of this project, and every chart is drawn in R from those files.

**Images.** All images are real photographs or archival scans, credited in captions. No image on this site is AI-generated. Archival maps, reports and photographs are from Georgia State University Library's digital collections; recent photographs are from Wikimedia Commons under the licenses shown.
